(2) The scene shifts to the woman posing in front of a white backdrop branded with 'Taipei Fashion Week', 'INFDARK', and 'Glenfiddich' logos. She crosses her arms and changes her stance confidently under bright outdoor lighting, while other people and camera equipment are partially visible at the edges of the frame. (3) The camera captures her inside a dark fashion show venue with professional stage lighting. Models are seen walking a runway in the background, wearing various stylish outfits including long coats and patterned shirts. The woman is shown sitting in the audience and later walking through the venue aisles, smiling and looking around. (4) A transition occurs to a close-up shot of a steaming pot of Korean chicken soup with green onions and garlic. The woman is then shown in a restaurant setting, using chopsticks to dip a piece of chicken into a sauce bowl and eating it with a satisfied expression. (5) Finally, she is seated in a cozy indoor cafe decorated with colorful anime posters on the walls. She talks to someone off-camera, laughing heartily while a small graphic of a male celebrity appears in the bottom right corner of the screen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio starts with a female speaker delivering energetic narration with a bright, medium-pitched voice. Upbeat, high-tempo pop music plays at a lower volume in the background, layered with faint outdoor ambient chatter. (2) A transition is marked by a synthetic 'whoosh' sound effect as the woman begins describing her nervousness at the fashion event. Her speech rate is moderately fast with expressive intonational peaks. (3) During the fashion montage, the audio focus shifts to rhythmic electronic music with a strong beat, punctuated by the mechanical 'click' of camera shutters to mimic professional photography. (4) The scene changes to a dining area where the sound of bubbling liquid is briefly audible, followed by the speaker's high-arousal vocal reaction as she tastes the food. Ambient restaurant room tone is present. (5) In the final phase, the female voice is accompanied by clear, loud laughter (both the speaker and a secondary off-camera female). The BGM remains consistent, maintaining a lighthearted and comedic atmosphere.
